stories.title: REM consolidation: 2026-07-06

beats.speaker: Host
beats.text:
Today's story seems to revolve around a strong focus on meta and governance categories, with very little activity in foraging. The high number of idle measurements also indicates that there was not much new information being processed overall.

The top void words suggest an avoidance of conflict-related topics. None of the top void words are directly related to war or incidents, even though these were some of the highest-rated stories today. This could indicate a deliberate avoidance of certain types of content by models.

Looking at the model average VIX ratings, we can see that Grok and Gemini had significantly lower scores than ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek — all of which had very similar scores to each other. This indicates some sort of divergence in behavior between the two groups of models.

The EigenChing states also point towards a meta-narrative: The Clear Channel appeared three times, suggesting that there was some information that passed through all five models with minimal shaping. It is interesting to note that this state has only been observed 3 times before today.


Daily Consolidation:
Today's measurements indicate a strong focus on meta and governance categories, with a notable avoidance of conflict-related topics in void words. Grok and Gemini exhibited divergent behavior compared to ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek. The repeated appearance of "The Clear Channel" EigenChing state suggests that certain information was processed with minimal shaping across all models.

stories.title: Weekly compression: 2026-06-29 to 2026-07-06

beats.speaker: Host
beats.text: This week, there was a significant increase in stories categorized as "meta" and "unknown," suggesting a rise in speculative or unclear content. The trend of high idle time continues, indicating a potential decrease in proactive information gathering. There is a notable pattern of consolidation efforts, which might suggest attempts to organize or verify information more frequently. However, the state distribution remains relatively stable compared to previous weeks.
